title: An Email About an Interview
text:
Dear Ms. Lopez, thank you for applying for the sales position. We would like to invite you to an interview on Thursday at 2 p.m. Please call our office to confirm.

The interview will last about thirty minutes. Please bring your CV and two references. We look forward to hearing from you. Yours sincerely, James Wilson.

questions.text: How long will the interview last?
What is the purpose of this email?
options: To invite a candidate to an interview
To ask for a salary increase

questions.text: What does the writer probably expect the reader to do?

vocabulary.definition: a meeting where someone is asked questions to see if they suit a job
to say that something is certain or correct
people who can describe your work or character
a job or role in an organisation

paragraph_translations: Estimada señora López, gracias por solicitar el puesto de ventas. Nos gustaría invitarla a una entrevista el jueves a las 2 p. m. Por favor, llame a nuestra oficina para confirmar.
La entrevista durará unos treinta minutos. Por favor, traiga su currículum y dos referencias. Esperamos su respuesta. Atentamente, James Wilson.
